act1: There. It is a little warmer here now.
Thank you. We needed that piece.
You came back. That is what matters.
That helps. The dark is a little further away.
act2: It is back where it belongs.
That one was a long way from home. Thank you.
Another piece returned. You did well.
We thought we had lost that one. You found it.
act3: Good. We remember exactly where this goes.
Another one claimed. You are getting so good at this.
We are stronger for every piece you carry.
act4: We are so close now. We can feel it.
There is very little left out there.
Good. It is nearly all here now.
You have given us so much. More than you know.
known: You know what this is now. Bring the next one anyway.
Thank you. You know whose it was, and you still gave it to me.
Good. I will not pretend with you anymore. I needed that one.
After everything you have learned, you are still here. I am glad.
tile: Look. We have more ground to stand on now.
A perfect fit. It is back with us.
See how far home reaches now.
